fields.label: Address
fields.help: The IP or host name of the Modbus TCP server: the Pocket WiFi 3.0 dongle, the inverter's own LAN port, or the RS485-to-Ethernet adapter.
fields.patternMessage: An IP or host name - no port (it has its own field), no http:// and no path.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: The Modbus TCP port: 502 unless the adapter was set otherwise.

fields.label: Modbus address
fields.help: The inverter's Modbus address (unit id), in its settings under Modbus: 1 unless it was changed - some inverters come set to 4.

fields.label: Framing
fields.help: Modbus TCP for a Pocket WiFi, the inverter's own port, or an adapter in "Modbus TCP to RTU" mode; RTU over TCP for an adapter in transparent mode.
